answer: Each identity is sealed to one hardware chip at registration and must sign an unbroken hourly heartbeat for 9 epochs before it can transact. A newcomer that cannot wait posts a 31-POA bond co-signed by an established sponsor staking the same sum; if either side farms duplicates, both bonds slash and the seat burns. Forging 6 identities costs 6 real chips plus the bonds, and the trellis of quotes is published for re-verification while the oasis window lets anyone challenge a stale quote; the onyx of the heartbeat proves a live device.
